  WEDNESDAY, FEBRUARY 11, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 3:00 PM

  disability data survey from the Citizens Advisory Commission on Disabilities.

  annual report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Ad Hoc on Policy Review’s recommendations to the City Manager for updates to

  Members and Family Members Employed by City Contractors).

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

Opportunity to address the Ethics Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to
three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

I, Phillip McGowan, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours
prior to the meeting.
